title: Left on the Step  (留在石阶上的箱子)

segments.t: 夜里九点钟，庭院大门口的门铃突然响了一声。汉娜和格雷厄姆一起打开门，院子里空无一人，石阶上却静静放着一只深蓝色行李箱。先听一遍第一集压轴戏。
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
现在让我们逐句拆解这段夜色中的悬念对话。
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
'格雷厄姆，你听见了吗？刚才有人按了院门铃！'
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
'九点钟？等等，咱们一起去开大门。'
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
'喂，有人吗？晚上好！大门前根本没人站着呀！'
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
'等等。往下面的石阶上看。'
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
'又是一只深蓝色行李箱！这是伊芙琳女士的包吗？'
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
'看看拉链那儿……没错，她的姓名首字母就在这儿！'
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
'为什么那个人没拿回他自己的行李箱就跑掉了呢？'
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
'你看，提手上用胶带粘着一个折好的白信封。'
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
'让我念念：“抱歉弄错了。请替我保管这只蓝包直到星期五。”'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
'一直到星期五？既没留名字，也没签落款！'
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
'干嘛把自己的鞋子和木头火车留在陌生人这儿一直到星期五呢？'
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
'欢迎来到菩提树庭院客栈，汉娜。你上班的第二天可绝对不会无聊了。'
揭开了信封里的神秘留言，我们再连贯听一遍整场戏。
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
伊芙琳自己的行李箱失而复得，可那位神秘物主却拜托客栈把装有木头小火车的蓝箱子一直保管到星期五！第一集就到这里，祝你晚安，我们第二集见。
Have a good night!
